approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Primary routing accepts the full Request for Information name, but exact workflow-reference extraction currently recognizes only the RFI abbreviation.
A Submittal or Email that says Request for Information No. 0042 therefore loses an otherwise exact RFI relationship.
Extend the existing deterministic reference pattern and reuse the current identifier normalizer; add no dependency, semantic inference, mailbox access or model call.
Offline parser and API regressions, specification sync and every bounded task context pack passed before completion.
title: Full-name RFI workflow references
objective: Preserve an exact digit-bearing RFI relationship when a supported document uses the full Request for Information name instead of the RFI abbreviation.
